questions.question: What are alcohol evaporators?

options.text: Devices that add alcohol to brake systems to prevent freezing.
Only allowed on vehicles carrying hazardous materials.

questions.correctAnswerText: Devices that add alcohol to brake systems to prevent freezing.
questions.explanation: Some air brake systems have an alcohol evaporator. It adds alcohol to the braking system to stop ice from forming, which can cause damage.

questions.question: What does rust around wheel nuts mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: The nuts are loose.
questions.explanation: Check your tires before every drive. Rust around wheel nuts usually means they are loose.

questions.question: What happens if the emergency air line loses pressure?

options.text: The tractor protection valve will close.
The rear trailer will detach from the truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The tractor protection valve will close.
questions.explanation: The tractor protection valve keeps air in the trailer's brakes if the trailer breaks away or leaks. When air pressure in the emergency line drops, the tractor protection valve closes and the emergency trailer brakes activate.

questions.question: What happens if a vehicle's Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) is not working?

options.text: The vehicle will have no brakes.
The vehicle will still be able to brake.
The vehicle will likely travel faster than usual.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle will still be able to brake.
questions.explanation: The Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) reduces brake pressure to prevent wheel lockup. If the ABS is not working, the basic braking functions still work. Drive and brake normally.

questions.question: If ice is on the front of your side mirror, what does this mean?

options.text: You can expect ice to be on the roadway.
There will not be ice on the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can expect ice to be on the roadway.
questions.explanation: If your mirrors or wiper blades become icy while driving, the road surface is likely icy too.

questions.question: How can alcohol be removed from your body?
questions.correctAnswerText: By waiting.
questions.explanation: Your liver removes alcohol from your body at a steady rate. The only way to sober up is to give your body time to remove the alcohol naturally.

questions.question: If a trailer begins to skid, what should the driver do?

options.text: Quickly turn the steering wheel left and right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Release the brakes.
questions.explanation: If your trailer skids, release the brakes to regain traction. The trailer will straighten out once the wheels grip the road again.

questions.question: Why is rolling backward when starting to accelerate dangerous?

options.text: The truck is not made to go backwards.
You may hit a vehicle behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may hit a vehicle behind you.
questions.explanation: Be sure you can accelerate without rolling backward. Rolling back may cause you to hit a vehicle or obstacle behind your truck.

questions.question: When a vehicle is started, what should the coolant temperature do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Rise slowly.
questions.explanation: After an engine starts, the coolant temperature should gradually rise to the normal operating range.

questions.question: What should you check on a coupling before a trip?

options.text: There is a space between the upper and lower fifth wheel.
The kingpin is free from all dirt and dust.
The locking jaws are closed on the kingpin.

questions.correctAnswerText: The locking jaws are closed on the kingpin.
questions.explanation: When checking a coupling, make sure there is no space between the upper and lower fifth wheel. Ensure the locking jaws are securely closed around the kingpin.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a distracted driver ahead?

options.text: Stay a safe distance away from the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay a safe distance away from the vehicle.
questions.explanation: When you see a distracted driver, give them plenty of space. Keep a safe distance between your vehicle and theirs.

questions.question: When should you slow down and be extra careful?
questions.correctAnswerText: When approaching a work zone.
questions.explanation: Slow down and be extra careful in work zones. Also be careful where the road edge drops off, when objects are on the road, and on freeway ramps.

questions.question: In a dual air brake system, how are the air tanks arranged?

options.text: Both systems share the same air tanks.
Each system has its own air tanks.
You must choose which system to use.

questions.correctAnswerText: Each system has its own air tanks.
questions.explanation: A dual air brake system has two separate systems. They share the brake controls, but each system has its own tanks, hoses, and lines.

questions.question: When backing up to couple a trailer, where should the tractor be positioned?

options.text: Straight in front of the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: Straight in front of the trailer.
questions.explanation: Position the tractor straight in front of the trailer. Backing at an angle can cause the trailer to move and break the landing gear.

questions.question: What does the Johnson bar do?

options.text: It is a hand valve that controls the trailer brakes.
It limits how much cargo you can carry.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is a hand valve that controls the trailer brakes.
questions.explanation: The Johnson bar is also called the trolley valve. It is used to work the trailer brakes. Use it only to test the brakes. Using it while moving can cause a skid.

questions.question: When should placards be used?

options.text: Any time a vehicle carries hazardous materials.
When there is extra space on the truck.
Only when hazardous materials weigh more than 200 pounds.

questions.correctAnswerText: Any time a vehicle carries hazardous materials.
questions.explanation: Use warning placards any time a vehicle carries hazardous materials. Place placards on all four sides of the vehicle.

questions.question: What should you do when entering a curve?
questions.correctAnswerText: Shift into a lower gear.
questions.explanation: Slow down to a safe speed before entering a curve. Shift into a lower gear.

questions.question: Before driving a vehicle with power steering, what should you check?

options.text: The hoses are connected to the battery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fluid level is correct.
questions.explanation: Check the hoses, pumps, and fluid level in a power steering system. Look for leaks in the hoses.

questions.question: How can you tell if your trailer is skidding?
questions.correctAnswerText: By checking your mirrors.
questions.explanation: Watch your mirrors to see if your trailer is jackknifing or skidding. This way you can spot the problem early.

questions.question: If your wheels spin when you accelerate on a slippery surface, what should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Release the accelerator.
questions.explanation: If your drive wheels spin on a slippery surface, take your foot off the accelerator.
